neet_bio_u04_t02_1.working: Calvin's 14C tracing showed the first stable product is the 3-carbon compound 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA).

neet_bio_u04_t02_2.working: One glucose needs 6 turns, using 18 ATP and 12 NADPH. Two glucose therefore need 36 ATP and 24 NADPH.

neet_bio_u04_t02_3.working: The water-splitting complex is associated with PS II on the lumen side of the thylakoid. It requires Mn2+ and Cl-.

neet_bio_u04_t02_4.working: The Calvin cycle runs in the bundle sheath cells of C4 plants and in C3 plants, so A is true. RuBisCO is the most abundant enzyme, so R is true. R does not explain A.

neet_bio_u04_t02_5.working: Each CO2 fixed needs 3 ATP and 2 NADPH, so 5 CO2 need 15 ATP and 10 NADPH; I is correct. Four glucose need 24 turns, not 4; II is incorrect.
